calculation.description: Negative directional efficiency over 20 sessions, scaled by positive-day breadth. Assets with persistent directional moves are assigned lower forecasts, capturing cross-asset exhaustion while preserving an interpretable trend-persistence conditioning term.

metrics.coverage_definition: average valid instruments divided by 15 on dates meeting the >=8-instrument IC requirement

validation.regime_notes: Full-history cross-asset validation across 15 tradable benchmark instruments; sign is intentionally reversal-oriented. Small cross-section implies conservative interpretation of uncertainty.
